PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IRI_EXPR
          IDENT "ex"
          SHAPE_SEP ":"
          IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "users"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          KW_IRI "iri"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          TERNARY_EXPR
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "cond"
            T_QUESTION "?"
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "a"
            SHAPE_SEP ":"
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "b"
